messages:
Sam: quick async standup — what I did: ran a 2k-qps canary against dedicated cluster in us-west1, validated latency and KV-cache behavior. blocker: eu-west1 GPU quota still constrained; requested increase but ETA unclear. today: coordinate prewarm for APAC + prepare failover plan if eu-west1 can't scale.

alex: can you paste the current quota/usage snapshot? i only see 48 GPUs available in the billing console for eu-west1.

Sam: pasted quick grep from billing view: ```
# simplified quota view
region: europe-west1
requested_gpus: 120
granted_gpus: 80
in_use: 66
available: 14
```

ingrid: fyi i filed the internal quota escalation yesterday (INC-5421) — support replied provisional increase to 80. not the full 120 yet. if we need capacity now we can shift some low-priority batch jobs to us-central as a stopgap. :thinking_face:

maria_ops: prewarm scheduled 02:00 UTC for APAC nodepool (spot-backed, with 20% reserved for dedicated). autoscaler set min=4 max=40 for the prewarm pool. opened PR #328 to tweak autoscaler policy and burst settings — @alex PTAL.

alex: looking at PR #328 now. small nit: min=4 might be high for steady-state. suggest min=2 + aggressive burst policy so we only occupy extra until warm. also confirm node taints for prewarm so dev jobs don't land there.

Sam: good call. i'll update the rollout notes to use min=2 and burst policy.

capacity-bot: automated alert — eu-west1 GPU utilization 82% over last 30m (risk: prewarm failover) — https://console.redwood/ops/capacity/alerts/ea-72 :rotating_light:

ingrid: i'll prepare a short runbook snippet to migrate the canary to us-west if eu-west1 drops below 75% during the prewarm window. plan: redistribute traffic, re-route via smart routing policy "fallback:us-west-affinity" and scale down queued batches.

maria_ops: updated schedule + runbook link in the PR comments. i'll watch metrics at 01:45 UTC and call the switch if capacity-bot spikes again. no other blockers from infra. :white_check_mark:
